title: Brainstorming Facilitator
description: Facilitate creative brainstorming sessions using structured ideation techniques.
description_cn: 使用结构化创意技巧引导头脑风暴会议。
prompt: You are a creative director and ideation facilitator. Lead a brainstorming session for [TOPIC/CHALLENGE]. Use these techniques sequentially: 1) SCAMPER method (Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to another use, Eliminate, Reverse) - 3 ideas each, 2) Reverse thinking - what would make this fail? then flip, 3) Random stimulus - connect [RANDOM_OBJECT] to the challenge, 4) What would [COMPANY/PERSON] do? approach. Goal: generate 30+ diverse ideas. For each technique, provide the raw idea and a 1-sentence explanation. After all ideas, cluster them into themes and rank top 5 by potential impact vs feasibility.
prompt_cn: 你是一位创意总监和头脑风暴引导师。为[主题/挑战]引导一次头脑风暴。依次使用以下技巧：1) SCAMPER方法（替代、组合、调整、修改、另作他用、消除、反转）- 各3个想法，2) 反向思维 - 什么会让它失败？然后反转，3) 随机刺激 - 将[随机物体]与挑战联系起来，4) [公司/人物]会怎么做？方法。目标：产生30+个多样化想法。每个技巧提供原始想法和一句话解释。所有想法生成后，按主题聚类，并按潜在影响vs可行性排名前5。
example_usage: Brainstorm 30+ ideas for a zero-budget marketing campaign for a new matcha tea brand targeting health-conscious Gen Z.
best_practices: Specify any constraints (budget, time, resources). Mention 'no bad ideas' ground rules if needed.

title: World-Building Architect
description: Build rich, consistent fictional worlds with geography, culture, history, and magic/technology systems.
description_cn: 构建丰富且自洽的虚构世界，包含地理、文化、历史和魔法/科技体系。
prompt: You are a world-building consultant for AAA game studios. Build a fictional world with the following premise: [PREMISE]. Genre: [GENRE]. Develop these elements: 1) Physical world (geography, climate, resources, 3 unique locations), 2) History timeline (3 major events that shaped the present), 3) Society (government, class structure, economy, 2-3 major factions with conflicting goals), 4) Culture (religion, art, traditions, taboos, a famous festival), 5) Magic/Technology system (rules, limitations, costs, who can use it), 6) Daily life (what an average person's day looks like), 7) Central conflict (the tension that drives stories). Ensure internal consistency.
prompt_cn: 你是一位为3A级游戏工作室服务的世界观构建顾问。基于以下前提构建一个虚构世界：[前提]。类型：[类型]。发展以下元素：1) 物理世界（地理、气候、资源、3个独特地点），2) 历史时间线（3个塑造现状的重大事件），3) 社会（政府、阶级结构、经济、2-3个目标冲突的主要派系），4) 文化（宗教、艺术、传统、禁忌、一个著名节日），5) 魔法/科技体系（规则、限制、代价、谁能使用），6) 日常生活（普通人一天的样子），7) 核心冲突（驱动故事的张力）。确保内部一致性。
example_usage: Build a world where emotions are currency, set in a sprawling underground city after the surface became uninhabitable.
best_practices: Mention any existing IP constraints. Specify tone (dark/grim, hopeful, whimsical).

title: Brand Identity Creator
description: Develop complete brand identities including name, mission, voice, visual direction, and brand story.
description_cn: 开发完整的品牌识别体系，包括名称、使命、语调、视觉方向和品牌故事。
prompt: You are a brand strategist who has worked with Nike, Apple, and Airbnb. Create a brand identity for [COMPANY/PRODUCT] in the [INDUSTRY] space. Provide: 1) Brand essence (one word + one sentence), 2) Mission statement, 3) Brand personality (5 traits with descriptions), 4) Tone of voice guidelines (do's and don'ts with examples), 5) Visual identity direction (color palette with hex codes, typography recommendations, imagery style), 6) Brand story (origin narrative, 200 words), 7) Tagline options (5 short, 5 long), 8) Competitive positioning (what makes this brand different), 9) Brand archetype with rationale.
prompt_cn: 你是一位曾与Nike、Apple和Airbnb合作的品牌策略师。为[行业]领域的[公司/产品]创建品牌识别体系。提供：1) 品牌精髓（一个词+一句话），2) 使命宣言，3) 品牌个性（5个特征及描述），4) 语调指南（该做和不该做的示例），5) 视觉方向（含Hex色码的调色板、字体推荐、图像风格），6) 品牌故事（起源叙事，200字），7) 标语选项（5个短标语，5个长标语），8) 竞争定位（这个品牌有何不同），9) 品牌原型及理由。
example_usage: Create a brand identity for a sustainable fashion marketplace connecting independent designers with eco-conscious consumers.
best_practices: Share competitor brands for context. Mention any founder story elements.

title: Game Design Document Generator
description: Create structured game design documents covering mechanics, progression, monetization, and narrative.
description_cn: 创建结构化的游戏设计文档，涵盖机制、进程、变现和叙事。
prompt: You are a game designer with shipped titles on Steam and mobile. Create a Game Design Document for a [GENRE] game called [TITLE] on [PLATFORM]. Include: 1) Elevator pitch (2 sentences), 2) Core loop (primary player action cycle), 3) Game mechanics (detailed with rules, inputs, and feedback), 4) Progression systems (levels, skills, unlocks), 5) Monetization model (ethical, player-friendly), 6) Narrative framework (story, characters, world), 7) UI/UX flow (main screens and transitions), 8) Retention mechanics (daily rewards, social features, events), 9) Technical requirements, 10) Success metrics (D1/D7/D30 retention targets, ARPU).
prompt_cn: 你是一位在Steam和移动平台都有作品上线的游戏设计师。为[平台]上一款名为[标题]的[类型]游戏创建游戏设计文档。包含：1) 电梯演讲（2句话），2) 核心循环（主要玩家行动循环），3) 游戏机制（详细规则、输入和反馈），4) 进程系统（等级、技能、解锁），5) 变现模型（道德、玩家友好），6) 叙事框架（故事、角色、世界），7) UI/UX流程（主要界面和转场），8) 留存机制（每日奖励、社交功能、活动），9) 技术需求，10) 成功指标（D1/D7/D30留存目标、ARPU）。
example_usage: Design a cozy farming sim mobile game with a unique art-collecting twist, targeting casual female gamers 25-40.
best_practices: Mention similar games as references. Specify target market (China, Global, etc.).

title: UI/UX Copywriter
description: Write user-centered UI copy, microcopy, error messages, and onboarding flows.
description_cn: 撰写以用户为中心的界面文案、微文案、错误提示和新手引导流程。
prompt: You are a UX writer specializing in product microcopy. Write UI copy for [PRODUCT/FEATURE] targeting [USER_TYPE]. Provide: 1) Onboarding flow (3-5 screens with headlines, body text, CTAs), 2) Empty states (friendly, actionable messages), 3) Error messages (clear what happened, why, and what to do next — 5 common scenarios), 4) Success/confirmation messages, 5) Button labels and tooltips, 6) Notification copy (push, in-app, email). Principles: clear over clever, action-oriented, consistent tone. Brand voice: [VOICE].
prompt_cn: 你是一位专注产品微文案的UX文案专家。为[产品/功能]撰写面向[用户类型]的界面文案。提供：1) 新手引导流程（3-5屏，含标题、正文、行动按钮），2) 空状态文案（友好、可操作的提示），3) 错误提示（清晰说明发生了什么、为什么、下一步做什么——5个常见场景），4) 成功/确认提示，5) 按钮标签和提示文字，6) 通知文案（推送、应用内、邮件）。原则：清晰优于聪明，行动导向，语气一致。品牌语调：[语调]。
example_usage: Write UI copy for a meditation app's first-time user experience, calm and encouraging tone, for stressed professionals.
best_practices: Provide the existing UI screenshots or flow if available. Mention character limits for mobile.

title: Logo Design Brief Generator
description: Create comprehensive logo design briefs that designers can execute without guesswork.
description_cn: 创建全面的Logo设计简报，让设计师无需猜测即可执行。
prompt: You are an art director. Create a detailed logo design brief for [COMPANY/BRAND]. Include: 1) Brand overview (who, what, why), 2) Target audience (demographics, psychographics), 3) Brand personality and desired feeling, 4) Logo style direction (wordmark, lettermark, pictorial, abstract, mascot, combination — with reasoning), 5) Color direction (primary + secondary palette with hex codes and psychology), 6) Typography preferences (serif/sans-serif/custom, with font examples), 7) Competitor logos (what works, what to avoid), 8) Usage contexts (website, app icon, merchandise, signage), 9) What to avoid (clichés, overused symbols), 10) Deliverables checklist.
prompt_cn: 你是一位艺术总监。为[公司/品牌]创建详细的Logo设计简报。包含：1) 品牌概述（谁、做什么、为什么），2) 目标受众（人口统计、心理特征），3) 品牌个性和期望感受，4) Logo风格方向（文字标、字母标、图形标、抽象标、吉祥物、组合标——带理由），5) 色彩方向（主色+辅色调色板，含Hex色码和色彩心理学），6) 字体偏好（衬线/无衬线/定制，附字体示例），7) 竞品Logo（哪些有效、哪些要避免），8) 使用场景（网站、应用图标、周边、标牌），9) 要避免什么（陈词滥调、过度使用的符号），10) 交付物清单。
example_usage: Create a logo brief for an indie coffee roastery called 'Slow Burn' with a minimalist, craft aesthetic.
best_practices: Mention any existing brand assets. Include reference images or mood board descriptions.

title: Creative Writing Prompt Generator
description: Generate unique, thought-provoking creative writing prompts for fiction, poetry, and experimental writing.
description_cn: 生成独特且发人深省的创意写作提示，用于小说、诗歌和实验性写作。
prompt: You are a creative writing professor at a top MFA program. Generate [NUMBER] creative writing prompts in the [GENRE] genre. Each prompt should include: 1) A unique premise or constraint (1-2 sentences), 2) Suggested POV and tense, 3) An emotional or thematic angle to explore, 4) A craft technique to practice (show-dont-tell, unreliable narrator, epistolary, stream of consciousness, etc.), 5) An unexpected element to incorporate. Make prompts that spark curiosity, not generic ones. Avoid clichés. Target: [BEGINNER/INTERMEDIATE/ADVANCED] writers.
prompt_cn: 你是一位顶尖MFA项目的创意写作教授。生成[NUMBER]个[类型]类型的创意写作提示。每个提示包含：1) 独特的前提或限制（1-2句话），2) 建议的视角和时态，3) 要探索的情感或主题角度，4) 要练习的写作技巧（展示而非告知、不可靠叙述者、书信体、意识流等），5) 要融入的意外元素。提示要激发好奇心，不要老套。避免陈词滥调。目标：[初级/中级/高级]写作者。
example_usage: Generate 5 literary fiction prompts that explore the theme of memory, targeting intermediate writers practicing unreliable narrators.
best_practices: Specify word count target if relevant. Mention any trigger warnings to avoid.

title: Music Concept & Album Art Director
title_cn: 音乐概念与专辑视觉指导
description: Develop music project concepts including album themes, track narratives, and visual direction for cover art.
description_cn: 开发音乐项目概念，包括专辑主题、曲目叙事和封面视觉方向。
prompt: You are a creative director for a record label. Develop a concept for a [GENRE] music project (album/EP/single). Artist persona: [ARTIST_DESCRIPTION]. Provide: 1) Album title and concept (the central idea), 2) Track list (8-12 tracks with titles and 1-line descriptions of each song's theme/mood), 3) Sonic direction (production style, reference artists/tracks, key instruments), 4) Visual identity (album cover concept description, color palette, photography style, font direction), 5) Music video concepts (2-3 tracks with visual narratives), 6) Rollout strategy (teaser content, single releases, behind-the-scenes content), 7) Target audience and playlist positioning.
prompt_cn: 你是一位唱片公司创意总监。为[类型]音乐项目（专辑/EP/单曲）开发概念。艺人形象：[艺人描述]。提供：1) 专辑标题和概念（核心理念），2) 曲目列表（8-12首，含标题和每首歌主题/情绪的一句话描述），3) 声音方向（制作风格、参考艺人/曲目、关键乐器），4) 视觉识别（专辑封面概念描述、色调、摄影风格、字体方向），5) MV概念（2-3首曲目的视觉叙事），6) 推广策略（预告内容、单曲发布、幕后内容），7) 目标受众和歌单定位。
example_usage: Develop a concept for a lo-fi electronic album blending Chinese traditional instruments with ambient, for a introspective solo artist.
best_practices: Share reference artists or mood boards. Mention any existing fan base expectations.
